newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Arabia beheads man for shooting over money.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabia beheads man for shooting over money.

text.p: Saudi Arabia beheaded a Saudi man on Friday for shooting dead a compatriot after a dispute over money, Saudi state television reported.
The beheading raised to 60 the number of people executed in the conservative Islamic kingdom so far this year.
A Saudi man was beheaded on Wednesday for murder and on Tuesday four Pakistanis -- two women and two men -- and a Nigerian man were beheaded for drug smuggling.
Saudi Arabia strictly enforces Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading by the sword convicted murderers, drug smugglers, rapists and other criminals.
